roomBeat.name: Fractured Star Map
roomBeat.title: The missing star blinks twice.
roomBeat.description: Aster marks the impossible point before the engine answers with three iron knocks from below.

npc.name: Mira
lines: The old observatory woke up again.
Every lens is pointing at the same impossible star.
If the engine below is singing, something ancient is listening.
Take this spark and go carefully. It likes courage, not panic.
